outcome.work_intent_goal: Mature mncs-compiler for reliable native multi-module application development while advancing verified self-consumption
outcome.direct_git_object_hash_readback: all four selected compiler evidence blobs matched their ledger SHA-256 values when read from the compiler repository object database without modifying it; the Environment projection correctly continued to label them outside-selected-session
outcome.interpretation: The active compiler session's Work Intent names mncs-compiler, but the selected session omits that repository. Its newest bounded evidence page therefore yields no Environment-verified observations or pressure hypotheses, although four exact compiler evidence records are referenced and their Git object hashes match when independently read. The current projection exposes the selection mismatch and outside-selected diagnostics in separate fields, but does not join them into an explicit actionable pressure candidate. The evidence does not establish that the mismatch blocked compiler work.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Compiler campaign evidence is outside the selected session context
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: mncs-environment workspace selection and campaign evidence visibility
pressure_hypothesis.basis: A read-only projection of the active compiler campaign reported 693 evidence references. Its newest selected page contained four compiler observation references, all classified outside-selected-session because the Work Intent declares mncs-compiler while the selected checkout set contains mncs-environment, mncs-language, and mncs-vm. The projection produced zero verified observations and zero pressure hypotheses. Independent read-only Git object reads matched all four recorded hashes, but did not change the Environment session's source-verification status.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Expose this observed scope mismatch as an explicitly labeled pressure candidate linked to the Work Intent and outside-selected source diagnostics. Preserve the current access boundary; inspection of compiler evidence still requires an authorized session that selects the exact checkout.
